answer: Simultaneous Spacetime-Cell Attestation: each identity binds to a tamper-resistant token that must answer a random challenge in a random 100 ms epoch, proving presence in a disjoint 3D cell via RF round-trip ranging to three independent beacons. A token may wander between cells, but one operator cannot occupy two cells at once; a hollow identity lacks a token and fails at the nadir of participation. Attacker cost: one deployed physical token per concurrent sybil, plus maintenance; spoofing requires simultaneous multiple locations or corrupting independent beacons.
